ImportWeb.PageTitle: Import recipe from any web page
ImportWeb.PageSubtitle: Paste a URL. The import-web plugin fetches the page, extracts a recipe, and lets you edit it before saving.
ImportWeb.VideoSubtitle: Paste a video URL. The plugin reads the captions, asks the LLM to turn them into a recipe, and lets you edit it before saving.
